title: How to learn and revise better for psychology interviews and exams

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news!
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息！

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正寻求成为一名心理学家，那么让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist Podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客在身边，你将走上由 Marianne Trent 博士主持的《有抱负的心理学家播客》之路。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for coming back regularly to listen to what I've got to say and what my guests have got to say too.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们经常回来收听我想说的话，以及我的嘉宾们想说的话。

sentences.en: Or this might be your first ever episode.
sentences.zh: 或者这可能是你收听的第一集。

sentences.en: If it is, then welcome along.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，欢迎加入。

sentences.en: Why not subscribe whilst you're here?
sentences.zh: 既然来了，何不订阅一下呢？

sentences.en: And if you're watching on YouTube, subscribe, like, comment, engage, do all those good things.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在 YouTube 上观看，请订阅、点赞、评论、互动，做所有那些好事。

sentences.en: If you are listening on Apple Podcasts, even if you're not, I'd love it if you would take a moment to go along and rate and review the podcast series.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在 Apple Podcasts 上收听，即使不是，我也很希望你能花点时间去给这个播客系列评分和评论。

sentences.en: If you really like the podcast series and you think it's useful, I'd love it if you consider buying me a cup of herbal tea,
sentences.zh: 如果你真的很喜欢这个播客系列并认为它很有用，我很希望你能考虑请我喝杯花草茶，

sentences.en: which you can do by going to my link tree on my socials and clicking donate.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过访问我社交媒体上的 Linktree 并点击捐赠来实现。

sentences.en: It does cost me a few hundred pounds a month to produce the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 制作这个播客确实每月要花费我几百英镑。

sentences.en: So if you do find the content helpful and you can afford to buy me a cup of herbal tea, I'd be so very grateful.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你觉得内容有帮助，并且负担得起请我喝杯花草茶，我会非常感激。

sentences.en: There is also a link in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 节目说明中也有一个链接。

sentences.en: So I know because many of you have been in contact that you are all at different stages of your career.
sentences.zh: 我知道，因为你们中的许多人一直与我保持联系，你们都处于职业生涯的不同阶段。

sentences.en: Some of you are doing GCSEs.
sentences.zh: 你们中的一些人正在读 GCSE。

sentences.en: Some of you are doing A-levels.
sentences.zh: 你们中的一些人正在读 A-level。

sentences.en: Some of you are doing your degree.
sentences.zh: 你们中的一些人正在攻读学位。

sentences.en: Some of you are doing your master's.
sentences.zh: 你们中的一些人正在攻读硕士学位。

sentences.en: Some of you are doing your doctorate or your PhD.
sentences.zh: 你们中的一些人正在攻读博士学位。

sentences.en: Some of you are even already qualified.
sentences.zh: 你们中的一些人甚至已经获得了资格。

sentences.en: So we've got a really big, broad area.
sentences.zh: 所以我们涵盖的领域非常广泛。

sentences.en: Some of you are even working in an unrelated career, considering coming across and jumping ship to the good ship psychology.
sentences.zh: 你们中的一些人甚至在从事不相关的职业，正在考虑跨界，跳槽到心理学这艘好船上。

sentences.en: So I try to create content that's going to be useful for you, whatever level you're at.
sentences.zh: 所以我尽量创作对你们有用的内容，无论你处于什么水平。

sentences.en: And I will make sure that I'm trying, where possible, to reference how this can be relevant for you, wherever you're at right now.
sentences.zh: 我会确保在可能的情况下，提及这对你目前所处的阶段有何关联。

sentences.en: So, obviously, interviews can come up at any time of the year.
sentences.zh: 显然，面试可能在一年中的任何时候进行。

sentences.en: Exams tend to be sort of summerish.
sentences.zh: 考试通常在夏季左右。

sentences.en: But if you're doing modular courses, they might be all year long as well.
sentences.zh: 但如果你参加的是模块化课程，它们也可能全年进行。

sentences.en: Right now, as I record this, this is going out in March, but I'm recording this in February 2023.
sentences.zh: 现在，当我录制这段内容时，这是在三月份发布，但我是在 2023 年 2 月录制的。

sentences.en: We are in the swing of interview season for educational psychology and clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于教育心理学和临床心理学的面试旺季。

sentences.en: We are starting to hear whether people have got interviews.
sentences.zh: 我们开始听到人们是否获得了面试机会的消息。

sentences.en: So I thought it'd be really useful, because I know we all have busy, busy lives,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这会非常有用，因为我知道我们都有非常忙碌的生活，

sentences.en: to think about some of the revision or learning techniques that don't work as well as we might think they do.
sentences.zh: 去思考一些效果不如我们想象中那么好的复习或学习技巧。

sentences.en: And then come in and talk to you about the ones that evidence has shown us.
sentences.zh: 然后我会进来和你谈谈证据向我们证明有效的那些方法。

sentences.en: We love a bit of evidence, don't we?
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢证据，不是吗？

sentences.en: The evidence has shown us does work.
sentences.zh: 证据向我们证明了它是有效的。

sentences.en: I'm not going to leave you high and dry, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，我不会让你陷入困境的。

sentences.en: As ever, we do have our compassionate Q&A session.
sentences.zh: 一如既往，我们有富有同情心的问答环节。

sentences.en: So if you do need or want some extra support with the application or interview process, regardless of what you're at right now, where you're at,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你确实需要或想要在申请或面试过程中获得额外支持，无论你现在处于什么阶段，

sentences.en: you can come along to the sessions and ask me questions.
sentences.zh: 你都可以来参加这些会议并向我提问。

sentences.en: So let me just talk you through the dates we've got for those coming up.
sentences.zh: 让我带你了解一下即将到来的日期。

sentences.en: OK, so the compassionate Q&A dates, they're all free and they're across my socials.
sentences.zh: 好的，富有同情心的问答日期，它们都是免费的，并且会在我的社交媒体上发布。

sentences.en: A great place to hang out to make sure you catch it is in the free Facebook group, which is the Aspiring Psychologist Community with Dr. Marianne Trent, brackets, free group.
sentences.zh: 确保你不错过的一个好地方是免费的 Facebook 群组，即“与 Marianne Trent 博士一起的心理学家社区（免费群组）”。

sentences.en: You can also catch it live on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 你也可以在 YouTube 上观看直播。

sentences.en: I'm basically Dr. Marianne Trent in all of the social media places, so you can catch it there.
sentences.zh: 我在所有的社交媒体平台上基本上都是 Dr. Marianne Trent，所以你可以在那里找到我。

sentences.en: So the first session will be happening on Monday, the 13th of March, 2023 at 7.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 所以第一场会议将于 2023 年 3 月 13 日星期一晚上 7 点 30 分举行。

sentences.en: And if when you're listening or watching this, you're like, well, that date's already passed, Marianne, then you'll be able to catch it on replay on my YouTube channel,
sentences.zh: 如果你在收听或观看时觉得，好吧，那个日期已经过去了，Marianne，那么你可以在我的 YouTube 频道上观看重播，

sentences.en: Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 玛丽安·特伦特医生。

sentences.en: Like, subscribe, do all those good things whilst you're there.
sentences.zh: 点赞、订阅，在观看时做所有那些好事。

sentences.en: Come on, be kind.
sentences.zh: 来吧，善良一点。

sentences.en: And our second session of this year will be on Monday, the 17th of April, 2023 at 7.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我们今年的第二场会议将于 2023 年 4 月 17 日星期一晚上 7 点 30 分举行。

sentences.en: And our third will be Tuesday because of the little bank holiday on the Monday, the 2nd of May, 2023 at 7.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 第三场将是星期二，因为周一有个小银行假日，时间是 2023 年 5 月 2 日晚上 7 点 30 分。

sentences.en: And if you're listening to this and it's totally the wrong time of year for you and you're thinking, well, actually, I'm applying for stuff, I'm not preparing for interviews,
sentences.zh: 如果你在收听这段内容，而现在对你来说完全不是那个时间，你在想，好吧，实际上，我正在申请东西，我没有在准备面试，

sentences.en: then we've got your bases covered there as well.
sentences.zh: 那么我们也为你考虑到了。

sentences.en: On Dr. Marianne Trent's channel, you can access all of the replays for previous Q&A sessions for application season, not just interview season two.
sentences.zh: 在 Dr. Marianne Trent 的频道上，你可以访问申请季之前所有问答环节的重播，不仅仅是面试季的。

sentences.en: So let's get on with the content for today's episode.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们开始今天这一集的内容吧。

sentences.en: And I do hope you find it useful.
sentences.zh: 我确实希望你觉得它有用。

sentences.en: So the first of the techniques for preparing for exams and interviews that doesn't really work that well, but evidence suggests we think it works quite well, is rereading.
sentences.zh: 所以，准备考试和面试的第一种技巧，虽然效果不是很好，但证据表明我们认为它效果相当不错，那就是重读。

sentences.en: So rereading chapters or notes you've made or, you know, summary things doesn't work as well as other strategies.
sentences.zh: 所以重读章节或你做的笔记，或者你知道的总结性东西，效果不如其他策略。

sentences.en: So this research was put together by a psychologist called Dunlowski.
sentences.zh: 这项研究是由一位名叫 Dunlosky 的心理学家整理的。

sentences.en: And they found that there was some limited evidence that it does work, but that because it's a passive learning technique, that it sort of works, but it's not the most effective.
sentences.zh: 他们发现有一些有限的证据表明它确实有效，但因为它是一种被动学习技巧，所以它有点效果，但不是最有效的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I was, to be honest, blown away because I always thought that was the thing to do, that rereading, you're just rereading a whole book or, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，老实说，我感到很震惊，因为我一直认为那是该做的事情，重读，你只是重读整本书，或者你知道的，

sentences.en: particular chapters on topics was gonna, was gonna blow things out of the park.
sentences.zh: 关于主题的特定章节会产生巨大的影响。

sentences.en: So, um, if you are also like, what, um, then listen on, um, because I need to tell you more about the other stuff that doesn't work as well as we might think it does.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，如果你也像是在说“什么？”，嗯，那么继续听下去，嗯，因为我需要告诉你更多关于其他效果不如我们想象中那么好的东西。

sentences.en: Okay, so the second thing that might, well, blow your mind is highlighting and underlining.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以第二件可能会，嗯，让你大吃一惊的事情是高亮和下划线。

sentences.en: That is one of the things that was absolutely my go-to, um, lining up the desk, getting all the highlighters ready, getting the little tab markers to mark stuff.
sentences.zh: 那绝对是我首选的事情之一，嗯，整理书桌，准备好所有的荧光笔，准备好小标签来标记东西。

sentences.en: That was my bag, baby.
sentences.zh: 那是我的拿手好戏，宝贝。

sentences.en: But actually, there's been evidence to suggest that not only does it not help with our performance,
sentences.zh: 但实际上，有证据表明，它不仅对我们的表现没有帮助，

sentences.en: that sometimes it can hinder our performance because it means that we are learning things in too narrow a sphere, really.
sentences.zh: 有时它甚至会阻碍我们的表现，因为它意味着我们在一个太狭窄的范围内学习东西，真的。

sentences.en: And what it doesn't help us to do is to make inferences.
sentences.zh: 而且它不能帮助我们进行推理。

sentences.en: And, of course, in psychology, being able to link things to other areas can be really, really important.
sentences.zh: 当然，在心理学中，能够将事物与其他领域联系起来可能非常非常重要。

sentences.en: Whereas if we boiled it all down to, you know, one or two lines, then really our knowledge is not super dense, is it?
sentences.zh: 而如果我们把它全部归结为，你知道，一两行，那么我们的知识确实不够扎实，不是吗？

sentences.en: You know, it's surface level at beSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，充其量只是表面水平。

sentences.en: So, um, don't worry, I'm not going to leave you high and dry.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，别担心，我不会让你陷入困境的。

sentences.en: I'm not going to leave you with all the stuff that doesn't work and then not tell you about the stuff that does.
sentences.zh: 我不会只留下所有不起作用的东西，然后不告诉你那些起作用的东西。

sentences.en: So, listen on or watch on and there's more great things coming too.
sentences.zh: 所以，继续听或看，还有更多很棒的东西即将到来。

sentences.en: Now, when people are asked again about whether they feel that highlighting, um, is going to be a useful strategy, they absolutely think it is.
sentences.zh: 现在，当人们再次被问及他们是否觉得高亮，嗯，将是一个有用的策略时，他们绝对认为是的。

sentences.en: And even when they're told that it's not that helpful, they might still like to engage in it because it feels kind of comforting, like a safety blanket.
sentences.zh: 即使在被告知它并没有那么有用时，他们可能仍然喜欢参与其中，因为它感觉有点安慰，就像一条安全毯。

sentences.en: So, absolutely carry on doing it if you would like to, but do bear in mind there's other techniques that can skyrocket your performance in interviews and tests too.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你愿意，绝对可以继续这样做，但请记住，还有其他技巧可以让你在面试和测试中的表现突飞猛进。

sentences.en: Okay, so the third thing that isn't working as well as we think it might is summarising or making notes.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以第三件效果不如我们想象中那么好的事情是总结或做笔记。

sentences.en: It's been found, again by Dunlosky, that it's got pretty low utility in helping us learn stuff, helping us remember stuff, helping us recall the stuff when we need to.
sentences.zh: 同样由 Dunlosky 发现，它在帮助我们学习东西、帮助我们记住东西、帮助我们在需要时回忆起东西方面的效用相当低。

sentences.en: And the theory is,
sentences.zh: 理论是，

sentences.en: is we're not summarising effectively or efficiently and we need to be either taught how to do that better or just give it a miss altogether because there's other strategies that do work better.
sentences.zh: 我们没有有效或高效地进行总结，我们需要要么被教导如何更好地做到这一点，要么干脆放弃它，因为有其他策略确实更有效。

sentences.en: It's not something that I was taught at school or uni.
sentences.zh: 这不是我在学校或大学里被教导的东西。

sentences.en: You might well have been and if you're using advanced skills in summarising, you might be knocking it out the park.
sentences.zh: 你很可能被教过，如果你正在使用高级的总结技巧，你可能做得非常出色。

sentences.en: But many of us are winging it and just doing what we think is going to be beSt.
sentences.zh: 但我们中的许多人只是在应付，只是做我们认为最好的事情。

sentences.en: So, yeah, if you do like these things, then do continue to use them, but maybe also use the other techniques that I'm going to be talking to you about too.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果你确实喜欢这些东西，那么请继续使用它们，但也可能同时使用我将要和你谈论的其他技巧。

sentences.en: If you are a passionate note taker or you want to use modern ways to think about your preparing or testing yourself, I have been really loving the Remarkable Tablet.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个热情的笔记记录者，或者你想使用现代的方式来思考你的准备或自我测试，我一直非常喜欢 Remarkable 平板电脑。

sentences.en: It's a paper-free tablet which really helps you organise yourself too.
sentences.zh: 它是一款无纸化平板电脑，确实也能帮助你组织自己。

sentences.en: If you'd like £40, I think it's £40 rather than $40 off code, then check out the link in the show notes or send me a DM.
sentences.zh: 如果你想要 40 英镑，我想是 40 英镑而不是 40 美元的折扣码，那么请查看节目说明中的链接或给我发私信。

sentences.en: So, let's take a little break here and I will be back along to talk you through the strategies that are really going to help you get to be where you want to be.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们在这里休息一下，我会回来带你了解那些真正能帮助你达到你想要的目标的策略。

sentences.en: Whether that's passing your exam, whether that is being able to, you know, do as well as you can in your interviews.
sentences.zh: 无论是通过考试，还是能够，你知道，在面试中尽你所能表现出色。

sentences.en: I will catch you on the other side of this.
sentences.zh: 休息过后我会回来。

sentences.en: Hello, my name is Avalon and I'm an undergraduate psychology student.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫 Avalon，我是一名心理学本科生。

sentences.en: I really enjoyed reading the Aspiring Psychologists Collective and I really honestly just couldn't put it down.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢阅读《有抱负的心理学家集体》，老实说，我真的爱不释手。

sentences.en: I found it really helpful because as I'm in my final year, I'm starting to think about what I'd like to do after uni.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它非常有帮助，因为我正处于最后一年，我开始思考毕业后想做什么。

sentences.en: And up until this point, I've been very set on the idea of pursuing an AP role.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，我一直非常坚定地想要追求一个助理心理学家（AP）的角色。

sentences.en: And the Aspiring Psychologists Collective helped me to see that there are so many more options out there that may appeal to me.
sentences.zh: 而《有抱负的心理学家集体》帮助我看到，外面还有很多可能吸引我的选择。

sentences.en: And I'm looking forward to exploring some needs and broadening out my options.
sentences.zh: 我期待着探索一些需求并拓宽我的选择。

sentences.en: And I also really appreciated that people were open about their lived experience and how they navigated over their psychology journey.
sentences.zh: 我也非常感谢人们公开分享他们的生活经历，以及他们是如何在心理学之旅中摸索前行的。

sentences.en: I had lived experience of an eating disorder, so it was really inspiring to hear about how people have brought that into their reflections
sentences.zh: 我有过饮食失调的生活经历，所以听到人们如何将这些经历带入他们的反思中，真的非常鼓舞人心，

sentences.en: and how it shaped the clinicians that they are today.
sentences.zh: 以及它如何塑造了他们今天成为的临床医生。

sentences.en: OK, welcome back.
sentences.zh: 好的，欢迎回来。

sentences.en: So in the first half, we were speaking about the techniques for revision or learning that actually don't serve us as well as we think they do.
sentences.zh: 所以在上半部分，我们谈论了实际上对我们帮助不如我们想象中那么大的复习或学习技巧。

sentences.en: And that is that is rereading, highlighting and summarizing.
sentences.zh: 那就是重读、高亮和总结。

sentences.en: So if you have stumbled into this and you want to know why that doesn't serve us as well, then skip back to the start and then come back to this point and we'll pick up from there.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你偶然发现了这一点，并且想知道为什么它对我们帮助不大，那么跳回到开头，然后再回到这一点，我们将从那里继续。

sentences.en: If you are still with us, you're listening or watching, then please do like, subscribe, comment and engage.
sentences.zh: 如果你还在和我们在一起，你在收听或观看，那么请点赞、订阅、评论并互动。

sentences.en: So what works?
sentences.zh: 那么什么有效呢？

sentences.en: Great question.
sentences.zh: 好问题。

sentences.en: So the first of the techniques that's going to start to work really, really well for you is what's called active recall,
sentences.zh: 所以第一种开始对你非常非常有效的技巧被称为“主动回忆”，

sentences.en: because that is thought to be much more efficient than just cramming the stuff in there.
sentences.zh: 因为这被认为比仅仅把东西塞进去要高效得多。

sentences.en: So the theory is that when we're trying to get stuff out of our brain, it actually strengthens the neural pathways for us to be able to do so when we need to get it.
sentences.zh: 所以理论是，当我们试图从大脑中提取东西时，它实际上加强了神经通路，使我们能够在需要时提取它。

sentences.en: So we need to be able to practice getting that stuff that we've learned out.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要能够练习提取我们学到的东西。

sentences.en: We might do that by using practice tests, by doing practice interviews and popping ourselves on the spot.
sentences.zh: 我们可能通过使用练习测试、进行模拟面试和让自己处于现场来做到这一点。

sentences.en: And we might be able to do past exam papers as well.
sentences.zh: 我们可能也能做过去的考试试卷。

sentences.en: And you might be like, well, seriously, how much of a difference can this make?
sentences.zh: 你可能会说，好吧，说真的，这能有多大的区别？

sentences.en: And there's some evidence to suggest that it's 10 to 15 percent increase in performance just by having one practice test at the end of each study session that you do.
sentences.zh: 有一些证据表明，仅仅在每次学习结束时进行一次练习测试，表现就会提高 10 到 15 个百分点。

sentences.en: And there's other evidence to suggest that doing that can boost your performance between 30 and 60 percent.
sentences.zh: 还有其他证据表明，这样做可以将你的表现提高 30 到 60 个百分点。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Imagine that if whatever recent exam or interview situation you were in, your performance was boosted by 30 to 60 percent.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，如果你最近参加的任何考试或面试情况，你的表现提高了 30 到 60 个百分点。

sentences.en: And again, you might be like, no, that can't be as good as me rereading that chapter four times.
sentences.zh: 同样，你可能会说，不，那不可能像我把那一章重读四遍那么好。

sentences.en: That is totally the way to do it.
sentences.zh: 那绝对是该做的方法。

sentences.en: Evidence suggests that people that used active learning during four study sessions performed better than people who just read a chapter four times.
sentences.zh: 证据表明，在四次学习过程中使用主动学习的人比仅仅读了一章四遍的人表现更好。

sentences.en: Interestingly, students actually did rate in research that they thought active recall was going to be the least effective strategy for helping them to improve their performance.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，学生们在研究中确实评价说，他们认为主动回忆将是帮助他们提高表现的最无效的策略。

sentences.en: But it was found to be one of the most effective strategies.
sentences.zh: 但它被发现是最有效的策略之一。

sentences.en: So what have you got to lose?
sentences.zh: 所以你有什么损失呢？

sentences.en: Give it a whirl.
sentences.zh: 试一试吧。

sentences.en: Try out some active recall at the end of your study sessions and see how you go.
sentences.zh: 在学习结束时尝试一些主动回忆，看看效果如何。

sentences.en: So I'm going to take you through some techniques to help you do active recall, because you might be like, I really, I really know how to do that.
sentences.zh: 所以我将带你了解一些帮助你进行主动回忆的技巧，因为你可能会说，我真的，我真的知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: So let me guide you through those.
sentences.zh: 所以让我引导你完成这些。

sentences.en: There's other ideas in a book called Make It Stick as well.
sentences.zh: 在一本名为《认知天性》（Make It Stick）的书里还有其他想法。

sentences.en: And I will link that in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 我会在节目说明中链接它。

sentences.en: I wanted to also thank somebody who I follow for inspiring this podcast episode, Ali Abdaal.
sentences.zh: 我还想感谢我关注的一位激励我制作这一集播客的人，Ali Abdaal。

sentences.en: And he's a medic.
sentences.zh: 他是一名医生。

sentences.en: But I thought I'd make this specifically relevant to my psychology audience.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我应该让它特别与我的心理学受众相关。

sentences.en: So you might well be a big fan of flashcards.
sentences.zh: 所以你很可能是一个抽认卡的大粉丝。

sentences.en: You might well make your own flashcards.
sentences.zh: 你很可能自己制作抽认卡。

sentences.en: But technology has moved on a little bit.
sentences.zh: 但技术已经进步了一些。

sentences.en: And there is a flashcard app that you can use as well.
sentences.zh: 还有一款抽认卡应用你也可以使用。

sentences.en: And it's called Anki, A-N-K-I.
sentences.zh: 它叫 Anki，拼写是 A-N-K-I。

sentences.en: And what you can do is you can set the question or the prompt on the front of the flashcard.
sentences.zh: 你可以做的是，在抽认卡正面设置问题或提示。

sentences.en: And then on the back is the information that you need to be able to recall.
sentences.zh: 背面则是你需要能够回忆起来的信息。

sentences.en: So you're aiming to help that prompt on the front dig deep into your brain and help you with the active recall, help you with getting that information out there.
sentences.zh: 所以你的目标是利用正面的提示深入大脑，帮助你进行主动回忆，帮你把那些信息提取出来。

sentences.en: And with the Anki app, which is free, I believe, you can also rate how easy you find that.
sentences.zh: 使用 Anki 应用（我相信它是免费的），你还可以评价你觉得掌握得有多容易。

sentences.en: Easy, medium and hard.
sentences.zh: 简单、中等和困难。

sentences.en: And if you rate it as hard, it might well crop up again in 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 如果你评价为困难，它很可能会在 10 分钟后再次出现。

sentences.en: If you rate it as easy, it might not crop up again in your flashcard practice for a couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 如果你评价为简单，它可能在几周内的抽认卡练习中都不会再出现。

sentences.en: Because you still need to be able to access the easy stuff, don't you?
sentences.zh: 因为你仍然需要能够获取那些简单的内容，对吧？

sentences.en: But of course, the stuff that's harder to learn, you're going to need more exposure to.
sentences.zh: 但当然，那些更难学习的内容，你需要更多地接触。

sentences.en: So one of the things that can be really tricky and that people tell me is really tricky in psychology
sentences.zh: 心理学中有一件事非常棘手，很多人都跟我说这很难，

sentences.en: is being able to remember all of the studies and the research that they need to be able to quote and cite.
sentences.zh: 那就是记住所有他们需要引用和引证的研究。

sentences.en: You know, sometimes you might just write Smith et al., you know, 2020.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有时你可能只是写上“Smith 等人，2020 年”。

sentences.en: But it's really can be useful to remember as many of the authors as we can.
sentences.zh: 但如果能记住尽可能多的作者，真的会很有用。

sentences.en: And of course, be able to convincingly talk about the research.
sentences.zh: 当然，还要能够令人信服地谈论这些研究。

sentences.en: So being able to pop on the on the flashcard, the names of the authors and the year,
sentences.zh: 所以，把作者姓名和年份写在抽认卡上，

sentences.en: and then on the back, giving yourself a little summary of the research and then being able to almost regurgitate that
sentences.zh: 然后在背面给自己写一个研究摘要，并能够几乎一字不差地复述出来，

sentences.en: when you need to, either in an exam situation or in an interview situation, will make you look really, really whizzy.
sentences.zh: 当你需要时，无论是在考试还是面试中，都会让你看起来非常厉害。

sentences.en: You can even use that app when you're learning that information to begin with.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以在刚开始学习这些信息时就使用该应用。

sentences.en: So rather than taking notes, which we've been told is not that effective, you can literally make those flashcards as your notes as you're going along
sentences.zh: 所以，与其做笔记（我们被告知这种方法效果并不好），不如在学习过程中直接把那些抽认卡当作笔记，

sentences.en: and then use those as part of your active recall, either at the end of a lecture or the end of a study session.
sentences.zh: 然后在讲座结束或学习结束后，将它们作为主动回忆的一部分来使用。

sentences.en: It's that ability to test yourself as you go along that is going to really lay the foundations for that active recall.
sentences.zh: 正是这种边学边测的能力，将真正为你主动回忆打下基础。

sentences.en: It's not just passive strategies.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是被动策略。

sentences.en: OK, and the next of the strategies that's going to supercharge your abilities is making notes, but with the book closed.
sentences.zh: 好的，下一个能增强你能力的策略是做笔记，但要合上书。

sentences.en: So read what you need to read and then make notes based on what you can remember.
sentences.zh: 阅读你需要阅读的内容，然后根据你能记住的内容做笔记。

sentences.en: And then when you've made your notes, have a read through the book again.
sentences.zh: 做完笔记后，再把书通读一遍。

sentences.en: See what you've missed and then close the book and try to add to that on what you've missed.
sentences.zh: 看看你遗漏了什么，然后合上书，试着把你遗漏的内容补上。

sentences.en: You might well want to use strategies such as spider diagrams when you're doing that to link your learning to.
sentences.zh: 在做这些时，你可能想使用思维导图之类的策略来建立学习联系。

sentences.en: And the final of our techniques for really boosting your techniques in active learning
sentences.zh: 我们提升主动学习技巧的最后一种方法，

sentences.en: is rather than just making traditional notes, is to write questions for yourself based on the material.
sentences.zh: 不是只做传统的笔记，而是根据材料为自己编写问题。

sentences.en: So as you're learning it, write yourself questions and then answer them.
sentences.zh: 所以，在你学习的时候，给自己写问题，然后回答它们。

sentences.en: So why this works is because it really ramps up the cognitive effort involved in your learning.
sentences.zh: 这种方法之所以有效，是因为它真正增加了学习过程中的认知投入。

sentences.en: It's not purely passive.
sentences.zh: 它不是纯粹被动的。

sentences.en: We're not just sponges.
sentences.zh: 我们不仅仅是海绵。

sentences.en: We're not going to soak it up.
sentences.zh: 我们不会只是被动吸收。

sentences.en: When we do more with the stuff that we're learning, it's more likely that those neural pathways are going to be thrown down in the right way,
sentences.zh: 当我们对所学内容做更多处理时，这些神经通路就更有可能以正确的方式建立起来，

sentences.en: which is going to help us be able to find them again when we need to be able to get that stuff out of our brain.
sentences.zh: 这将有助于我们在需要从大脑中提取这些信息时能够再次找到它们。

sentences.en: So I hope you found this really useful.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你觉得这非常有用。

sentences.en: In summary, we want to be, you know, if it feels comforting, if it feels like a safety blanket, then you can still carry on making notes, summarising, highlighting and rereading.
sentences.zh: 总之，如果你觉得做笔记、总结、高亮和重读能给你带来安慰，像是一种安全毯，那你仍然可以继续这样做。

sentences.en: But really, in order to do ourselves the ultimate favour, it's really important that we seek to do as much active recall as we can.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，为了对自己负责，我们必须尽可能多地进行主动回忆，这一点非常重要。

sentences.en: And ways I would do this is I'd probably, over dinner, get my husband to ask me what I've learned today.
sentences.zh: 我个人的做法是，在吃晚饭时，让我的丈夫问我今天学到了什么。

sentences.en: That's another simple way that you could use.
sentences.zh: 这是你可以使用的另一种简单方法。

sentences.en: Or, you know, if you speak to your mum or a friend on the phone, you could say, you know, could you check in with me even on WhatsApp and ask what I've learned today?
sentences.zh: 或者，如果你在电话里和妈妈或朋友聊天，你可以说：“你能帮我检查一下吗？甚至在 WhatsApp 上问我今天学到了什么？”

sentences.en: And, you know, then parrot it out, either as a voice note or if you like to type, you could type it out.
sentences.zh: 然后，以语音笔记的形式复述出来，或者如果你喜欢打字，也可以打出来。

sentences.en: So you're really strengthening those neural pathways.
sentences.zh: 这样你就在真正强化那些神经通路了。

sentences.en: Or perhaps you could look at using your supervision sessions to talk about some of the things you've learned recently or some of the things you've read recently.
sentences.zh: 或者，你也可以考虑利用督导时间来谈谈你最近学到或读到的一些东西。

sentences.en: So you could use a portion of those supervision sessions to get you practising active recall or to get you practising interview techniques and styles.
sentences.zh: 你可以利用部分督导时间来练习主动回忆，或者练习面试技巧和风格。

sentences.en: If you're at uni or if you're learning in some capacity, then think about how you can test yourself among your cohorts, the people you're learning with.
sentences.zh: 如果你在大学学习，或者正在以某种身份学习，那么考虑一下如何与你的同学（和你一起学习的人）互相测试。

sentences.en: How could you set each other little study sessions so that you can all advance?
sentences.zh: 你们可以如何为彼此设置小型的学习环节，以便大家共同进步？

sentences.en: Because you don't, it's not, you know, it's not a conteSt.
sentences.zh: 因为这并不是一场比赛。

sentences.en: It'd be amazing if you all did really, really well.
sentences.zh: 如果你们都能表现得非常出色，那将是太棒了。

sentences.en: How have you found this episode?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这一集怎么样？

sentences.en: I hope you found it really useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它非常有用。

sentences.en: If you have, please do leave me a comment if you're watching on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 如果是的话，如果你是在 YouTube 上观看，请给我留言。

sentences.en: Please rate and review if listening on Apple Podcasts.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在 Apple Podcasts 上收听，请评分和评论。

sentences.en: Tell your friends about us.
sentences.zh: 告诉你的朋友们。

sentences.en: Tag, tag whoever you like on socials who you think might benefit from this content.
sentences.zh: 在社交媒体上标记任何你认为能从这些内容中受益的人。

sentences.en: Don't forget, we've got those compassionate Q&A sessions coming up as well.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，我们还有那些富有同情心的问答环节。

sentences.en: Now, we've got the first one on Monday, the 13th of March, 2023 at 7.30pm.
sentences.zh: 第一个环节是在 2023 年 3 月 13 日星期一晚上 7 点 30 分。

sentences.en: We've got the second on Monday, the 17th of April, 2023, also at 7.30pm.
sentences.zh: 第二个是在 2023 年 4 月 17 日星期一晚上 7 点 30 分。

sentences.en: And the third is Tuesday, the 2nd of May, 2023 at 7.30pm.
sentences.zh: 第三个是 2023 年 5 月 2 日星期二晚上 7 点 30 分。

sentences.en: And if you'd like even more advice, support and guidance, do consider coming along to the Aspiring Psychologist Membership,
sentences.zh: 如果你想要更多的建议、支持和指导，请考虑加入“有抱负的心理学家会员计划”（Aspiring Psychologist Membership），

sentences.en: where for £30 a month, we can really help supercharge your skills, expertise and confidence to get you where you'd like to be.
sentences.zh: 每月只需 30 英镑，我们就能真正帮助你提升技能、专业知识和信心，助你达到理想的目标。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: I'll look forward to catching up with you for the next episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast, which will be available for you from 6am on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我期待在下一集《有抱负的心理学家》播客中与你相见，该节目将于周一早上 6 点发布。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚取除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One2Money programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的 One2Money 项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022, and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家完成了他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的附属链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组策划会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我都在这里。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我都在这里。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
